title: Yes Bank Prosperity Cashback credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Prosperity Cashback card providing flat cashback on essential business transactions, milestone benefits, and easy redemption, crafted for startups and professionals.

eligibility: Spend ₹50,000 or more in the previous quarter (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec), you automatically qualify for this privilege in the subsequent quarter (Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep, Oct-Dec, Jan-Mar).
